defects: Over-delivery beyond 5%: PO ordered 100 EACH, receipt GR-7712 shows 118 EACH received and invoiced (18.0% over, tolerance 5%)
rationale: Unit price matches the PO exactly and tax recomputes to the cent, so the only issue is quantity: the receipt confirms 118 EACH against a PO of 100 EACH, an 18% over-delivery well beyond the 5% band in clause 4, making this a quantity defect requiring receiving action. Single defect, so no clause 11 escalation; HOLD sets payable to 0.00 per clause 12, with approver read from that net figure under clause 10.
